From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@finovatebank.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stakeholder mapping & procurement next steps - FinovateBank

Hi Samantha -

Great to meet you on the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

Call recap:
- Champion: Samantha Lee (you) - agreed to own internal coordination and procurement intro
- Economic buyer: Rajiv Chopra (CFO) - Samantha to confirm exact approval threshold
- Security/legal: Emily Nguyen (Head of Security) requested standard SOC2 + architecture diagram
- Key decision drivers: latency under 200ms for search workflows, predictable monthly committed capacity, and security controls (KMS + audit logs)

Proposed next steps:
1) I'll send our SOC 2 attestation and a short ROI deck (attached) by EOD - done
2) Can you introduce me to procurement and confirm the procurement contact + cadence? (Procurement form attached if it helps)
3) We'll schedule a 30-min procurement/contract call w/ Rishi (sales lead) and Dev (SE) - suggested Wed 10am PT
4) Dev will follow up with a brief security checklist for Emily to review

Attachments I'm including: SOC2_Attestation_Redwood_2026.pdf; Redwood_ROI_v2.pptx; FinovateBank_Procurement_Form.pdf

If that all looks right, can you confirm procurement contact and whether Wednesday 06/23 10:00am PT works for you and Rajiv?

Thanks - talk soon.

-
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@finovatebank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stakeholder mapping & procurement next steps - FinovateBank

Hi Marissa -

Thanks for the clear recap and for sending the attachments. Quick responses: 

- I'm happy to own coordination. I'll intro you to procurement (procurement@finovatebank.com) in a separate thread right after this - they own PO/contract terms.
- Rajiv (CFO) is the economic approver for anything > $75k ARR. I'll check his availability for the procurement call but he usually delegates the initial review to the finance lead.
- Emily Nguyen (Head of Security) should review the SOC2 and the security checklist. I'll loop her in on the procurement intro.

Wed 06/23 10:00am PT works for me; I'll confirm Rajiv after I loop procurement. If procurement needs a contracting template or SOW, please have a short statement of work ready - one page is ideal.

On procurement intro in 2 minutes.

Best,
Samantha
Senior Product Manager
FinovateBank

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: procurement@finovatebank.com, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@finovatebank.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + SOW stub and commercial options - Redwood x FinovateBank

Hi procurement team -

Thanks for taking this. Per Samantha's request, attaching a one-page SOW stub and a short commercial summary. High-level pricing options: 

- Dedicated Reserve: committed monthly GPU capacity with SLA (recommended for predictable throughput) - pricing redacted in thread; summary attached
- Hosted Consumption: pay-as-you-go for initial pilot (lower commitment, higher unit cost)

We're happy to sign FinovateBank's standard MSA + addendum, or use Redwood's standard agreement with an Appendix for data controls. Rishi (cc'd) will lead commercial terms and can share contract redlines quickly.

Next steps I propose:
- Schedule a 30-min procurement call (Wed 06/23 10:00am PT suggested) - confirm attendees
- Dev will send a short security checklist for Emily to review (attached separately)
- I'll prepare a short ROI one-pager tailored to the estimated monthly commit we discussed

Attachments: Redwood_ROI_v2.pptx (ROI one-pager), SOW_Stub_Redwood_OnePage.pdf

Thanks - looking forward to working through the intake.

-
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood security checklist + architecture notes

Hi Samantha / procurement / team -

Following up with the technical items Emily asked about on the call. Attached is a concise security checklist and a short architecture note that covers: 
- Data residency & VPC options (private deployment vs hosted)
- KMS integration and key management options
- Audit logs and retention windows we can commit to
- SOC2 attestation pointer (see Marissa's attachment)

I can join the call on Wednesday to answer any technical or architecture questions. If Emily prefers, I can also run a 20-min technical sync with her ahead of the procurement call.

Attachment: Redwood_Security_Checklist.xlsx

Thanks,
Dev Patel

dev_patel@redwood.com | (415) 555-0188

Thanks everyone - procurement confirmed and looped (procurement@finovatebank.com). Emily is OK to review the checklist ahead of time and will try to join the Wed slot. Rajiv asked to be invited to the procurement call but said he may dial in only for the commercial decision.

Confirmed: Wed 06/23 10:00am PT - invite to follow. I attached our Procurement Intake Form for your reference.

I'll keep coordinating internally; if you can send the brief contract template and ROI one-pager by EOD Monday that'll speed review.

Cheers,
Samantha
